text:
Ana (Partnerships): Hey team — AWS Marketplace + NVIDIA partner portal just asked for a security/compliance pack for the joint listing. They want SOC2 Type II (latest), external penetration test report, vulnerability scan summary, network/infra architecture diagram, dataflow/subprocessor list, SSO/SAML config proof, encryption-at-rest/in-transit notes, and the completed marketplace questionnaire. Deadline is next Tue EOD. Who can own pulling these together? cc @Mike (Security) @Natalie (Legal) :eyes:

Mike (Security): I can own the SOC2 and vuln summaries. We have SOC2 in the compliance drive (v2025). Pen test — last full external pen test was 2024-09, but the provider report is redacted for customers; we can produce an exec summary + remediation tracker. I'll check if the full PDF can be shared under the partner NDA.

Jess (Product): For the marketplace listing we'll need a short 'attestation' text too — one-liner we can paste into their portal about data handling. Also we should version the artifacts (SOC2_v2025.pdf, pen-test-exec-summary_2024-09.pdf).

Ryan (Engineering): I can export the infra diagram and a simplified dataflow (no secrets). Will output SVG + PNG and a short JSON list of subprocessors/services. ETA: Fri EOD. Example upload command for artifact bucket:
```
aws s3 cp SOC2_v2025.pdf s3://partner-artifacts/nvidia/1764101234-SOC2_v2025.pdf --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Also note our KMS key IDs and S3 encryption config are in the security repo; I'll include the snapshot.

Natalie (Legal): We'll need the partner DPA extract + subprocessors list and clarifying language for what we can share publicly vs under NDA. I'll check the marketplace contract template and confirm clauses we must surface. Owner: legal@redwood. If full pen-test is required, we may need a signed NDA with the marketplace rep.

Mike (Security): Checklist I'm tracking (short):
- SOC2 Type II (report + cover letter)
- Pen test exec summary + remediation tracker
- Recent authenticated vulnerability scan (Qualys/Trivy summary)
- Architecture diagram (network + dataflow)
- Subprocessor list + contact points
- SSO/SAML config screenshot + IdP metadata
- Encryption proof (KMS ARNs, TLS cert fingerprint)
- Incident response summary (last 12 months)
- Redaction guidance and allowed sharing per legal

ci-bot: Reminder: partnership artifact path /partners/marketplace/nvidia/ has 30d retention for uploads. Use the --no-delete flag if you want longer.

Ana (Partnerships): Nice checklist. Two quick Qs: 1) We also need the penetration test scope — do we have the scope doc? 2) Marketplace questionnaire: is it the standard AWS partner security questionnaire or vendor-specific?

Mike (Security): Scope doc = in thread: pen-test-scope_2024-09.pdf (security-reports repo). For questionnaires — usually the AWS vendor questionnaire plus some vendor-specific Qs. If NVIDIA requests anything extra for hardware attestation (TPM / secure boot) we might need separate artifacts from HW partner.

Ryan (Engineering): On TPM/hardware: we're not shipping firmware, but for the dedicated offering we do surface host attestation details — I can pull the HSM/KMS attestation snippets we share with customers.

Natalie (Legal): I'll start a short share matrix: what can be public vs NDA-only vs legal-review-only. Will post by Thu. Also mark any export-control or data residency notes.

Ana (Partnerships): Assignments then: Mike = SOC2 + pen-test summary + vuln scan; Ryan = diagrams + encryption proof + hardware attestation notes; Natalie = legal share matrix + DPA extract; Jess = marketplace attestation blurb + confirm form field names; I'll compile and deliver to the marketplace rep. Target internal consolidation by Mon noon so we can review and send before Tue EOD. :calendar:

Mike (Security): Got it. I'll add items to the security board and tag owners.

Ryan (Engineering): Upload path I'll use: s3://partner-artifacts/nvidia/1764101234/ — will create a signed link for Natalie + Mike.

Ana (Partnerships): Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker (NDA required or redaction issues), ping me and I'll escalate with the vendor contact. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Jess (Product): Quick note — let's ensure the attestation doesn't overpromise on backups/retention. Keep it factual and link to the docs we can publish.

Ana (Partnerships): Will do. I'll post a follow-up with the vendor contact + timeline once we have the consolidated pack.
